Identify the percentage of the world’s population living in places with high levels of air pollution,
from Source 1.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify two ways to reduce air pollution, from Source 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Which way of reducing air pollution do you think would have the most impact? Explain why.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain why air pollution is an important local issue.

text: Study Sources 1 to 3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘Air pollution is a problem in our town.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘There has been a decrease in the use of fossil fuels locally in the last year.’
How could you test this claim? You may consider the types of information, sources of evidence
or methods you might use.

text: Study Source 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify one prediction from Tadean’s statement.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain why Abdu’s statement might be biased.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Abdu’s or Tadean’s?
Your answer should consider both arguments and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different types of information used.

text: Study Source 4.
Your local politicians have decided to try to reduce air pollution in your city over the next five years.
They have suggested the following ways:
• increase taxes paid by businesses that pollute the air
• educate people about alternatives to fossil fuels
• encourage people to use less polluting forms of transport.
Which one of these suggestions would you recommend, and why?
In your answer you should:
• state your recommendation
• give reasons to support your recommendation
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
• consider different arguments and perspectives.
